instruction: What would raise the score: a README that opens with the idea in plain words and a 30-second example, the evaluation data moved out to a release or separate repo, and a trimmed-down core package.
scope: Lead with a plain-language introduction and short browser and terminal examples.
Publish a separate compact native download from the existing wheel on future Pages builds. Install from the extracted public-download artifact in CI and verify retrieval after deployment.
Link the research archive, prior implementations and advanced tools from secondary navigation while preserving their version-pinned source paths.
validation: Both browser README questions passed in real Chromium using the existing browser runtime.
A clean offline install from the locally built 313,318-byte native ZIP passed both README CLI questions. Wheel inspection found only the three runtime packages and distribution metadata.
Documentation inventory, infrastructure checks, and changed workflow YAML and shell syntax checks passed locally.
limitations: The evaluation archive still resides in the full repository. The independent downloadable package excludes the archive. Moving version-pinned inputs would require a migration of their workflows and references.
The public URL is created by the first deployment of this change.
next_steps: Validate the frozen archive and the public download in the normal release workflow when the candidate is submitted.
